name: manual_0d4176
claim: When a new GPU node (Windows or Mac) joins the LAN fleet, write its onboarding steps as one self-contained downloadable markdown that composes the existing canonical installers (first-run-install.sh, ensure_requirements.ps1) rather than re-deriving install steps inline — keeps a single source of truth and lets the next node's real gaps get fed back as doc edits instead of tribal knowledge.

decisions.notes: 3rd fleet node (2nd Windows, RTX 5080) onboarded via bin/orama-system/skills/first-run-setup/references/windows-node-onboarding.md, which wraps first-run-install.sh + ensure_requirements.ps1 + coord_pulse Task Scheduler registration instead of duplicating their logic. Keeps first-run-install.sh as the only place install steps are defined.
